title: Unveiling the structure and interactions of SOG1, a NAC domain transcription factor: An in-silico perspective.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过同源建模与HADDOCK对接，解析植物NAC转录因子SOG1与靶基因启动子DNA序列及蛋白互作的分子机制，属TF-DNA结合与互作建模研究，高度契合课题。
abstract: SOG1 is a crucial plant-specific NAC domain family transcription factor and functions as the central regulator of DNA damage response, acting downstream of ATM and ATR kinases. In this study, various in-silico approaches have been employed for the characterization of SOG1 transcription factor in a comparative manner with its orthologues from various plant species. Amino acid sequences of more than a hundred SOG1 or SOG1-like proteins were retrieved and their relationship was determined through phylogenetic and motif analyses. Various physiochemical properties and secondary structural components of SOG1 orthologues were determined in selective plant species including Arabidopsis thaliana, Oryza sativa, Amborella trichopoda, and Physcomitrella patens. Furthermore, fold recognition or threading and homology-based three-dimensional models of SOG1 were constructed followed by subsequent evaluation of quality and accuracy of the generated protein models. Finally, extensive DNA-Protein and Protein-Protein interaction studies were performed using the HADDOCK server to give an insight into the mechanism of how SOG1 binds with the promoter region of its target genes or interacts with other proteins to regulate the DNA damage responses in plants. Our docking analysis data have shown the molecular mechanism of SOG1's binding with 5'-CTT(N)(7)AAG-3' and 5'-(N)(4)GTCAA(N)(4)-3' consensus sequences present in the promoter region of its target genes. Moreover, SOG1 physically interacts and forms a thermodynamically stable complex with NAC103 and BRCA1 proteins, which possibly serve as coactivators or mediators in the transcription regulatory network of SOG1. Overall, our in-silico study will provide meaningful information regarding the structural and functional characterization of the SOG1 transcription factor.
abstract_zh: SOG1是植物特有的NAC结构域家族转录因子，作为DNA损伤反应的核心调控因子，在ATM和ATR激酶下游发挥作用。本研究采用多种计算机模拟方法，对SOG1转录因子及其来自不同植物物种的直系同源物进行了比较性表征。检索了超过一百个SOG1或SOG1样蛋白的氨基酸序列，并通过系统发育和基序分析确定了它们之间的关系。在选择性植物物种中，包括拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）、水稻（Oryza sativa）、无油樟（Amborella trichopoda）和苔藓（Physcomitrella patens），测定了SOG1直系同源物的多种理化性质和二级结构组分。此外，构建了基于折叠识别或穿线法及同源建模的SOG1三维模型，并对生成的蛋白质模型的质量和准确性进行了后续评估。最后，利用HADDOCK服务器进行了广泛的DNA-蛋白质和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用研究，以深入了解SOG1如何与其靶基因启动子区域结合或与其他蛋白质相互作用来调控植物DNA损伤反应的机制。我们的对接分析数据揭示了SOG1与其靶基因启动子区域中存在的5'-CTT(N)(7)AAG-3'和5'-(N)(4)GTCAA(N)(4)-3'共有序列结合的分子机制。此外，SOG1与NAC103和BRCA1蛋白物理相互作用并形成热力学稳定的复合物，这些蛋白可能在SOG1的转录调控网络中充当共激活因子或介导因子。总体而言，我们的计算机模拟研究将为SOG1转录因子的结构和功能表征提供有意义的信息。
